verdicts.reason: Both are the same broken leaderboard layout. The barrel photo, the hero image, is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail beneath the headline. The logo mark is reduced to an icon placed after the photo, and the divider dash floats on its own. The paper-texture fragment sits as a meaningless box, and the tagline is tiny and jammed against the right edge. The only difference is that the texture box sits at the far left edge in B and floats near the left in A. Neither choice fixes the scattered, hierarchy-less arrangement.
